answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 35049 Country: India Title: Khula Question: One person's wife offered and her husband accepted her khula. But now they want to live together again. Is it possible? If so, kindly give details. Answer ID: 35049 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1678/1678/M=1432) If the husband did khula granting the offer of khula from wife then one talaq bai'n took place. If they want to live together they can live after doing new nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
